I've put together the plan from what Workday and the other systems show right now. Three more events came in while I was checking, so the plan covers four events in three cases. No humans or owning teams need to be involved.

**Noah Patel (E1003): events 1 and 2 are one transfer.** He moved from Software Engineer to Sales Rep effective today, 2026-11-02. A separate event on 2026-11-01 made Noah Okafor (E1010) his manager. They're different people with similar names.
- **Workday** already shows the new state: Sales Rep, Sales org, cost center CC-3000 Sales, manager Noah Okafor. Nothing to write back.
- **Identity** (account acct-e8168561): our policy allows 0 days of overlapping access on a transfer, so the old engineering access comes off today.
  - Remove Eng-Git and VPN-Users.
  - Add Sales-CRM. It isn't a privileged group, and the access-conflict check found no clashes with All-Staff.
  - Keep All-Staff, the Office-E3 licence and the mailbox. Don't revoke his sessions or disable the account, because he isn't leaving.
- **Finance:**
  - Move his cost center from CC-1000 to CC-3000. The Workday cost center maps to CC-3000.
  - His expense approver is still his manager from before the transfer. Change it to Noah Okafor.
  - He has no open expense reports and no active card, so nothing else is needed.
- **Equipment:** nothing needed for a transfer.

**Mateo Nguyen (E1011): event 3 is a manager change.** He moved from Owen Iyer to Noah Okafor. Workday already shows this. The only fix is his expense approver in Finance, which still points to Owen Iyer. He has no pending reports.

**Leila Fischer (E1012): event 4 is the same manager change.** Same approver fix. She also has one report (exp-e5e138e2, 170) waiting on Owen Iyer. Changing her approver only affects reports she submits later, so this one needs to be moved to Noah Okafor separately.

Owen Iyer is still active and is Noah Okafor's manager. So I set approvers worker by worker rather than moving all of Owen's approvals at once, which would also catch people who still report to him.
